input.summary: Add a Company convenience termination right on 90 days' notice and cap the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 payments.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an express right for the Company to terminate for convenience on 90 days' written notice, and capped the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 payments, which is the maximum early-termination fee our playbook permits.

ops.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI specifying the Termination Date.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided, that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the payments made to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
